name: Petunia Lockwood

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), chapter 12: the 2025 Wight's numbers, Neutral, with Life Drain as its only attack. The words are ours. The ribbon rule is text only until the fight set-piece actions (engine E6) land.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.

traits.name: Green Ribbon
traits.summary: A faded ribbon at her throat holds her head on. While she is Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained, a creature next to her can untie it (Utilize action, DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check): her head falls and she is destroyed.
traits.text: A green ribbon at her throat holds her head on. While she is Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained, a creature within 5 feet of her can use the Utilize action to untie it with a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check. Her head falls, a spray of blood reaches 30 feet (DC 13 Constitution save or 1d6 necrotic damage), and she is destroyed. The ribbon is left behind.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.summary: DC 13 Con save by a creature within 5 ft or necrotic damage that also lowers its Hit Point maximum.

summary: A pale woman in a black mourning gown, a faded green ribbon at her throat and a cup of dark tea in her hands; her touch drains the life from the living.
